description: Autocomplete for the crafting table. It tracks what you craft, suggests recipes, and lets you take the result from the output slot without placing the rest of the ingredients!

mods.name: CraftSense
mods.description: A Minecraft mod that predicts crafting recipes in real-time, offering previews based on items in the crafting grid and adapting to your crafting habits over time.

releases.notes:
- Fixed a bug where you could stack unstackable items when crafting directly
- Added shift + click support
- Added customizable keybind to craft quickly (so instead of shift + click you can also just press a keybind)
- Added a (hopefully unnoticeable) cooldown when crafting with CraftSense
